verdict.rationale: Web-crawling products of this kind can run hosted services with public status pages, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack shows no public status page, uptime history, or incident postmortems for Crawl4AI. The 'Real-time Monitoring Dashboard' is a self-hosted system-metrics feature, an adjacent control rather than a public status page, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can check a public status page showing uptime history and past incident postmortems before committing to the service
